title: Katniss and Peeta Return for Haymitch's Big Moment
summary:
Spoiler warning! If you have not seen The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping yet, you may want to stop here. The prequel brings back two very familiar faces for its ending — Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark.

We have known for some time that Jennifer Lawrence's Katniss and Josh Hutcherson's Peeta would return in the film. If you have read the book, you know they come back for an epilogue. In late October 2026, Lawrence confirmed that Woody Harrelson, who plays the older Haymitch, is part of the scene too.

After Haymitch wins his games, he walks up to an ivy-covered structure: the old site of the annual reaping, where one boy and one girl were chosen to compete in the deadly Games.

There he is joined by Katniss and Peeta, who wish him a happy birthday. Reaping day always falls on Haymitch's birthday. They thank him for everything, and Haymitch says 'Nevermore' before departing.

The film gives the trio a hopeful ending, though the books take a darker approach. It is in theaters now.
why_it_matters: If you love the Hunger Games, seeing Katniss, Peeta and Haymitch together again is a happy way to end Haymitch's story.
